mapper.select: SELECT A.BILL_ID AS billId , A.PROJ_ID AS projectId , A.BILL_TITLE AS billTitle , A.BILL_AMT AS billAmt , A.TAX_BILL_DT AS taxBillDt , A.PAY_DT AS payDt , A.IS_PAID AS isPaid , A.ACTUAL_PAY_DT AS actualPayDt , A.BILL_REMARK AS billRemark , B.PROJ_NM AS projectName FROM TB_BILLING A LEFT JOIN TB_PROJECT B ON A.PROJ_ID = B.PROJ_ID WHERE A.BILL_ID = #{billId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BILLING WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND BILL_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
